name: mimo-vision
description: Analyze local or remote images through Xiaomi MiMo Vision from any MCP client that supports bundles.
long_description: MiMo Vision MCP gives text-only agents a lightweight image analysis tool. The extension reads local image paths or remote image URLs, sends the image to Xiaomi MiMo Vision, and returns a text description for downstream reasoning.

tools.name: mimo_image_analyze
tools.description: Analyze an image using Xiaomi MiMo Vision. Supports local image file paths and http(s) URLs.

mimo_api_key.title: MiMo API Key
mimo_api_key.description: Paste only the raw key value, for example sk-xxxx. Do not include MIMO_API_KEY=, quotes, or spaces.
